title: Gandhari
plot_overview: After a mother loses her eyesight and her daughter in a kidnapping, she refuses to remain helpless. Taking matters into her own hands, she sets out to hunt down the people responsible for the devastating loss and bring the circumstances surrounding the kidnapping into focus.
will_you_like_this: You may like this if you enjoy determined protagonists and tense revenge stories; Not for you if you prefer lighter plots, ensemble adventures, or stories without intense personal stakes.
review_summary: Pros: determined central premise; personal stakes; revenge-driven tension | Cons: limited context; familiar setup; no review details
